entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return some shoes.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I get your full name and order number?

Thank you, Jane. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered about 81 days ago. To make sure I document this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They're awful. They give me blisters every time I ride.
I'm very sorry to hear that; comfort is key for a good workout. Just to confirm, there's no defect with the shoes themselves, like the cleats not attaching correctly?
No. I just don't like them. I want a refund.
Understood. Let me just confirm the return policy for this item... Yes, it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you immediately.

Okay, I've just initiated that for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label now. Just box the shoes up and drop them off at any carrier location. And because you're a VIP member with us, and to apologize for the trouble with the blisters, I've also added a $20 credit to your VeloFit account for a future purchase.
Yes, that's everything. The email with the label should arrive in the next few minutes. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope your next ride is more comfortable. Have a good day.
